page_title: VIL 3-4 BAR | Villarreal v Barcelona 27/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' The number of shots on goal at present is 6:11.
90+4' Barcelona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+2' Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' A cross from Juan Foyth (Villarreal) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
86' That's the end of the game for Ilkay Gundogan, who is replaced by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
86' Today's match ends for Dani Parejo who will be replaced by Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal).
85' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
82' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
80' Matteo Gabbia (Villarreal) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
78' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for an infringement.
77' Quique Setien prepares a substitution. Alex Baena is replaced by Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal).
76' Here comes a substitution. Ansu Fati (Barcelona) is brought on as a substitute for Lamine Yamal.
75' The attendance for today's match is 21679.
71' 3 - 4 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 3:4.
71' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the right post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
70' The game has come to an end for Gerard Moreno. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal).
70' Quique Setien decides to make a substitution. Ramon Terrats will be replaced by Santi Comesana (Villarreal).
70' Substitution. Denis Suarez (Villarreal) in, Etienne Capoue out.
68' 3 - 3 Goal! Ferran Torres (Barcelona) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:3.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Barcelona.
63' Substitution. Oriol Romeu walks off the pitch and Ferran Torres (Barcelona) comes on as a substitute.
63' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Gavi (Barcelona). Alejandro Hernandez saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
62' An attempted cross from Juan Foyth (Villarreal) is cleared.
57' Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) picked up a yellow card from referee.
56' OFF THE WOODWORK! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot that smashes against the crossbar!
54' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
50' 3 - 2 Alfonso Pedraza finds Alex Baena (Villarreal) with a sweet pass inside the penalty box, who then smashes the ball inside the right post. What a clinical finish to make it 3:2.
49' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
46' Half-time substitution. Xavi decided to make a change. Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) is replaced by Eric Garcia.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) picks up a yellow card.
45+6' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) is the one who receives a yellow card.
45+5' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
45+3' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
44' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.

43' That didn't go as planned! Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Filip Jorgensen, who easily kept it out.
42' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Alejandro Hernandez signals that the goal stands! The Villarreal players celebrate.
41' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Villarreal players aren’t happy.
40' 2 - 2 Goal! Alfonso Pedraza puts the ball on a plate for Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 2:2.
35' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
34' Matteo Gabbia (Villarreal) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
33' A cross into the box from Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) is cleared.
31' Alex Baena (Villarreal) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Marc-Andre ter Stegen to dive and make a save.
30' Gavi (Barcelona) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
28' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
26' 1 - 2 Juan Foyth (Villarreal) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:2.
25' Alex Baena (Villarreal) takes the corner.
23' The corner is swung in but Barcelona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
21' A pass by Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
18' None of the Barcelona players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

17' Marcos Alonso (Barcelona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
15' 0 - 2 Goal! Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.

12' 0 - 1 GOAL! Lamine Yamal produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Gavi (Barcelona) rises high to head the ball into the bottom right corner and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 0:1.
11' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Barcelona comes to nothing.
10' Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
7' Alex Baena (Villarreal) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
7' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Marcos Alonso (Barcelona), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
5' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
3' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Villarreal will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
